messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: [P0] Nereid-Enterprise (tenant:NRE-55) — elevated 5xx rate in eu-west dedicated pool. Error class: GPU_OOM / model-load-fail. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Start: 2026-03-15T10:12:34Z. Link: https://monitoring/redwood/incidents/2273456789

 tom-sre: ack — I'm oncall. paging in. pulling logs + pool health now. @sanjay-eng can you check dedicated-euw-42 nodes (GPU mem, OOMs)? I'll prepare warm pool attach and DNS plan.

 sanjay-eng: on it. seeing repeated OOMs on worker-42-*. kernel OOM logs + model reloads. KV cache churn high, GC spikes. suspect a memory regression after last runtime kernel update. starting isolations: taking a couple of workers OOS, spinning warm instances.

 maya-pm: customer impact: Nereid SRE reports ~40% failed requests for their production cluster, and a subset of users experiencing 503s. They've asked for ETA and whether we'll failover. I'll draft comms.

 tom-sre: short-term plan: 1) attach warm reserved pool (eu-west-warm) for NRE-55, 2) warm KV caches, 3) gradually steer traffic (10% increments) then flip DNS TTL to point to warm endpoint. If warm attach fails, fallback to eu-central. Will coordinate with support for customer notifications.

 opsbot: Runbook excerpt for warm attach + DNS steer:

 ```bash
 # attach warm pool to tenant
 ri infra attach-pool --tenant NRE-55 --pool eu-west-warm --mode warm
 # verify health endpoints
 curl -sS https://eu-west-warm.health/redwood/tenants/NRE-55/health | jq
 # patch routing weights (example)
 ri route patch --tenant NRE-55 --weights eu-west=80,eu-west-warm=20
 # DNS change (via dns-manager) - set CNAME to warm endpoint and lower TTL to 30s
 dnsctl set-cname nereid.example.com eu-west-warm.redwood.net --ttl 30
 ```

 Follow checks: monitor 5xx rate, latency p50/p95, and GPU_OOM counter.

 sanjay-eng: warm pool attach started. warming KV/cache shards now — warming progress: 60% shards complete. model load times ~8s initially, cooling to ~2.2s as caches fill. ETA ~6m to reach production-ready. Posting logs: 
```
worker-attach: started attach for tenant NRE-55 to pool eu-west-warm
shard-3: warming 42%
shard-7: load model v1.12 -> success
OOM-count: decreasing
```

 tom-sre: prepping DNS cutover. @nate-support please coordinate customer comms: we'll start traffic shift in ~10m once warm at 80%. Send advisory: "activating warm capacity and doing rolling DNS; short errors may occur; we will notify when complete."

 nate-support: sending T-10m advisory to Nereid SRE now. including rollback contacts and timeline. will escalate via their pager if errors spike again. :email:

 ellie-eng: I'm taking handoff at +20m (planned rotation). will watch the final shift and be the fallback lead. tom, remain if you want but i'm primary after handoff.

 incident-bot: METRICS SNAPSHOT: pre-mitigation 5xx=42% p95=750ms; after initial 20% shift 5xx=18% p95=310ms. GPU_OOM counter trending down.

 sanjay-eng: warm pool at 100% warmed. proceeding with staged routing change: now applying 50% weight to eu-west-warm. Command executed:
```
ri route patch --tenant NRE-55 --weight eu-west-warm=50,eu-west=50 --origin incident-2273456789
```
Observing error drop to <5% within 2m.

 tom-sre: errors now <2% across core endpoints. initiating final 100% shift. changing DNS CNAME to point to eu-west-warm endpoint and keeping TTL 30s for quick rollback. Propagating now.

 incident-bot: DNS EVENT: change propagated to ~85% of resolvers after 90s. No new major 5xx spikes. Traffic fully on warm pool. Marking mitigation: traffic shifted, warm pool active.

 maya-pm: customer update sent: Nereid confirmed service restored for core flows. They've requested a postmortem and timeline. Filing INC ticket INC-2026-0031 and will schedule postmortem with Nereid SRE.

 tom-sre: follow-ups: 1) roll back runtime kernel change on a canary to validate regression, 2) add automated early warm attach to run when tenant 5xx>10% for 3min, 3) update runbook for NRE-55 bespoke warm-flow. Passing active watch to ellie. great work team. :tada:

 ellie-eng: taking watch. I'll open the postmortem draft, capture exact timestamps + graphs and add the commands used. Will close active paging in 30m if metrics stay stable. :thumbsup:
